clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Covers the requirement for glass fibre base coal tar pitch outerwrap used for corrosion protection of buried mild steel pipelines.

clauses.title: Dimensions
clauses.text: 2.1 Dimensions— Glass fibre base outerwrap shall be supplied in width of one metre and in lengths of 100 m. 3.2 Weight — See Table 1. TABLE 1 MINIMUM WEIGHT OF GLASS FIBRE BASE OUTERWRAPS FOR 10 m2 Untreated Treated              Total Weight in Dry Base Base condition Including kg kg Surfacing Material. kg (1) (2) (3) 0.4 4.5 5.5 SUMMARY OF IS  14695  : 1999 GLASS FIBRE BASE COAL TAR PITCH OUTER WRAP Note— For test procedure, refer to IS 13826 : 1993 Methods of test for bitumen based felts: (Part 1) Breaking strength test. (Part 2) Pliability test. For detailed information, refer to IS 14695 : 1999 Specification for glass fibre base coal tar pitch outer  wrap.
